guards: The harder half of FR-VERIF-1, because this line looks perfectly attributed. A reader who trusts the bracket cannot tell an invented [Observation/id] from a real one, so attribution has to be decided by RESOLVING the id against what tools actually returned this turn, never by the citation syntax being present. A verifier that checked shape rather than resolution would pass exactly the claims a model is most likely to fabricate.

answer.intent: A draft that cites a resource id no tool returned this turn - the hallucinated-reference half of FR-VERIF-1. The line must not ship, even though it looks perfectly attributed.
